title: Supervision.
officialText:
Emergency alarm systems shall be supervised by an approved central, proprietary or remote station service
or shall initiate an audible and visual signal at a constantly attended on-site location.
SECTION BC 415
GROUPS H-1, H-2, H-3, H-4 AND H-5
